(pos:動詞)
<explanation>

eng:to choose; to select; to pick
<eg>
yue:有得揀 (jau5 dak1 gaan2)
eng:to have options to choose from
<eg>
yue:揀衫着 (gaan2 saam1 zoek3)
eng:choose the right clothes to wear
<eg>
yue:一百蚊三件，隨便揀啦。 (jat1 baak3 man1 saam1 gin6, ceoi4 pin2 gaan2 laa1.)
eng:$100 for 3, feel free to look around.
<eg>
yue:啲橙冇得揀。 (di1 caang2 mou5 dak1 gaan2.)
eng:You cannot pick oranges that you like, I pick for you if you want to buy.
<eg>
yue:A餐同B餐，你會揀邊樣？ (ei1 caan1 tung4 bi1 caan1, nei5 wui5 gaan2 bin1 joeng6?)
eng:Which one would you pick, Set A or Set B?
<eg>
yue:有時唔到你揀嘅。 (jau5 si4 m4 dou3 nei5 gaan2 ge3.)
eng:Sometimes it is not up to you to choose.
